name: claude-security-reviewer
description: An opinionated security review agent and stack-agnostic checklist skill for Claude Code. Reviews web projects (Node, Python, Go, Rust, Java) for secrets, auth gaps, IDOR/BOLA, SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, missing headers, weak rate limiting, CORS, cookie flags, dependency issues, SSRF, and pre-deploy hygiene.
